metadata.title: Clicked like I was poking the void and somehow scared off that 1 unlucky soul
metadata.description:
Tapping like I forgot how shooting works
That 1 poor enemy definitely puzzled beyond repair
Did NOT deserve this accidental chaos but hey, free kill vibes
Tap if your aim’s mostly happy accidents too!

Tap if you’re mostly luck and zero skill like me!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
